title: Twenty Minutes of Reasons to Use the RemedyBG Debugger
summary: Casey Muratori gives a fast tour of the RemedyBG debugger for Windows, which he uses daily. He shows its speed and features, especially the watch window.
why: HN points to it as a demonstration of what fast, well-built developer tooling looks like and of why a debugger beats print statements.

quote.text: Here's Casey Muratori demonstrating all the way in which RemedyBG rocks.
